name: IGEV-Stereo
plain: An iterative stereo network by Gangwei Xu et al. (geometry encoding volume with ConvGRU updates), with several fine-tuned checkpoints.
summary: IGEV-Stereo (Xu et al. 2023): iterative geometry encoding volume, a 3-D regularised group-wise correlation volume refined by ConvGRU updates, 32 iterations.

papers.title: Iterative Geometry Encoding Volume for Stereo Matching

limitations: The original code's dtu.ckpt (IGEV-MVS, another architecture) is not included.
task_io: Input: a rectified left / right image pair. Output: a disparity map (pixels, left view).
